title: Crystal Structure Prediction and 0 K Stability Assessment of Hypothetical Re(3)Zr Polymorphs: Vibrational, Elastic, and Electronic Properties.
authors: Mamatyusup, Mardan; Wei, Qun; Lin, Zhengzhe; Luo, Jing; Zhang, Meiguang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Re3Zr金属间化合物的晶体结构预测与稳定性，对象为无机合金而非蛋白质，且不涉及蛋白质结构计算或可迁移的AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
abstract: Re(3)Zr has recently been proposed in the cubic Pm-3n structure. Its alternative atomic arrangements and thermodynamic position within the Re-Zr system have not been systematically resolved. In this work, CALYPSO particle-swarm structure searches combined with density functional theory identify five Re(3)Zr polymorphs with Cmcm, Fmmm, Immm, P4/mmm, and Fm-3m symmetries and compare them consistently with the reported Pm-3n phase. Formation enthalpies, a selected-phase partial convex hull, phonon dispersions, elastic properties, sound velocities, elastic Debye temperatures, electronic structures, and bonding characteristics are evaluated. All five CALYPSO structures lie below Pm-3n in fixed-composition energy, with Cmcm being the lowest. The Cmcm phase has a formation enthalpy of -0.257 eV atom(-1) and lies approximately 0.042 eV atom(-1) above the selected-phase partial hull, identifying it as a low-lying off-hull metastable candidate at 0 K. AIMD simulations at 300 and 1000 K show no obvious structural reconstruction of the Cmcm framework over the simulated time scales. All six structures exhibit no imaginary phonon frequencies and satisfy the corresponding mechanical-stability criteria. Their elastic responses are strongly structure dependent: P4/mmm has the largest Chen-Tian hardness estimates and elastic Debye temperature, whereas Fm-3m shows the weakest elastic anisotropy. All six polymorphs are metallic, with Fermi-level states dominated by Re-5d orbitals and predominantly delocalized bonding. These results provide a thermodynamically constrained 0 K reference for future synthesis, phase identification, and finite-temperature or kinetic investigations of hypothetical Re(3)Zr polymorphs.
abstract_zh: Re(3)Zr最近被提出具有立方Pm-3n结构。其替代原子排列及在Re-Zr体系中的热力学位置尚未被系统解决。在本工作中，CALYPSO粒子群结构搜索结合密度泛函理论识别出五种具有Cmcm、Fmmm、Immm、P4/mmm和Fm-3m对称性的Re(3)Zr多晶型物，并与已报道的Pm-3n相进行一致比较。评估了形成焓、选定相的部分凸包、声子色散、弹性性质、声速、弹性德拜温度、电子结构和键合特征。所有五种CALYPSO结构在固定组成能量上均低于Pm-3n，其中Cmcm为最低。Cmcm相的形成焓为-0.257 eV atom(-1)，且位于选定相部分凸包上方约0.042 eV atom(-1)处，将其识别为0 K下低能离凸包亚稳态候选物。在300和1000 K下的AIMD模拟显示，在模拟时间尺度内Cmcm框架无明显结构重构。所有六种结构均无虚声子频率，并满足相应的力学稳定性判据。其弹性响应强烈依赖于结构：P4/mmm具有最大的Chen-Tian硬度估计值和弹性德拜温度，而Fm-3m显示出最弱的弹性各向异性。所有六种多晶型物均为金属性，费米能级态主要由Re-5d轨道主导，且键合主要为离域特征。这些结果为假设性Re(3)Zr多晶型物的未来合成、相识别及有限温度或动力学研究提供了热力学约束的0 K参考。
